subject: Summit Edge — request to update banking and billing contact
messages:
From: Nadia Torres <nadia.torres@summitedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Summit Edge Accounts <accounts@summitedge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Change of bank account / billing contact for Redwood payments

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from Summit Edge — our finance team switched bank providers last week and we'd like to update the remittance information you have on file. We also need to change the primary AP contact for purchase orders to a new colleague.

Summary of what we need updated in your vendor system:
- New ACH account & routing (bank: Harborview Bank)
- New remit address: 1203 Union Ave, 5th Floor, Portland, OR 97209
- New AP contact: Miguel Alvarez (miguel.alvarez@summitedge.com, +1 503-555-0187)

I've attached the signed ACH authorization, an updated W-9, and a short company letter confirming the change. Please confirm what documents you need on your side and any steps we should follow (portal update, signed vendor forms, or PO re-association).

Thanks — appreciate a quick confirmation so we can keep payments flowing.

Best,
Nadia Torres
Head of Finance Operations
Summit Edge, Inc.
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Nadia Torres <nadia.torres@summitedge.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 09:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of bank account / billing contact for Redwood payments

Hi Nadia — thanks for the heads up and the attachments.

We can process the vendor record changes but will need the following to complete the update in our AP system:
- Completed vendor update form (attached below) signed by an authorized officer
- Voided check or recent bank letter (you mentioned the ACH auth; a bank letter/voided check speeds verification)
- Confirmation whether the tax ID has changed (we have the old W-9 on file; you sent an updated one, thanks)

Next steps from our side:
- Lauren (Procurement) will queue the vendor profile change and coordinate with Finance for a verification call if needed.
- Marissa (Accounts Payable) will run our bank validation process and confirm the effective date for future POs.

If you can return the signed vendor update form and a voided check or bank letter, we should be able to make the change within 3 business days. If you prefer, we can accept the DocuSign ACH link you included — just confirm the signer.

Attached for your convenience: Redwood vendor update form (fill & return to procurementsupport@redwood.ai).

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Summit Edge Accounts <accounts@summitedge.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Nadia Torres <nadia.torres@summitedge.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of bank account / billing contact for Redwood payments

Karthik — attaching the documents you requested.

Attachments:
- SummitEdge_signed_ACH.pdf (e-signed by CFO, Daniel Price)
- SummitEdge_W9_2026.pdf
- SummitEdge_company_letterhead.pdf (bank letter included on letterhead)

We completed the DocuSign for the ACH (DocuSign ID in the related links). The tax ID remains the same. Miguel Alvarez is authorized to be the primary AP contact for POs and invoice submission.

Let us know if you need a quick verification call (we're available Mon/Tue morning PST).

Thanks,
Accounts Payable — Summit Edge
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Summit Edge Accounts <accounts@summitedge.com>, Nadia Torres <nadia.torres@summitedge.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 12:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Change of bank account / billing contact for Redwood payments

Hi Nadia / Summit Edge team — all good on our side, thanks for the quick turnaround.

I ran the bank validation and the DocuSign ACH came through with the CFO's signature. We have the updated W-9 and company letter on file. We'll update the vendor remit bank details and primary AP contact effective on the next payment cycle (payschedule 2026-11-30). A few notes: 
- Please continue to submit invoices to invoices@summitedge.com (we'll route POs to Miguel going forward).
- If you have any outstanding invoices that need to be paid to the old account before the cutover, flag them to me and we'll prioritize.

I'll update the vendor profile now and post a short confirmation once the change is live.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Accounts Payable Manager
Redwood Inference
